verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder, so built-in AI features for generated apps are a fair axis. The evidence never shows a way to add LLM calls or agents to the app with managed provider keys. The backend item covers data storage, while MCP and web search are context-gathering features for the building agent, not runtime AI features in the generated app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself
